verdict.rationale: The only evidence is thin: the API uses a versioned path (/v1/batch), and the OCR model has a versioned identifier (ocr-4-1). Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or version-lifecycle guarantees, so only the versioning half of the story is glancingly supported. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy, model/API lifecycle and retirement schedules, changelog or migration guidance, and independent corroboration of versioning stability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
